integrity: The publisher full text was inspected at the defining PMF/survival formulas, moment formulas Eqs. (18)-(22), Table 1, abstract, and tail interpretation. The correction is independently derived from the PMF and verified by a standalone checker. The heavy-tail terminology is compared with a published standard exponential-moment definition.
scientific_limitations: The complete higher-moment table is not independently reconstructed.
The likelihood and Bayesian estimation sections are not reassessed.
The source's order-statistic formulas are outside this finding.
title: Exact DZL tail-sums correct its moments and show a light tail
